summary.text: Stuart Schmidt is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 33B, in Anne Arundel County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A real estate professional, he has served in the House since January 2023 and is a Deputy Minority Whip.

paragraphs.text: Schmidt was born in Anne Arundel County and graduated from Glen Burnie High School.
He earned a B.S. in business administration and marketing from Salisbury University in 2002 and an M.B.A. in entrepreneurship from the University of Baltimore in 2014.
He worked for Perdue Farms and Mountaire Farms, and since 2010 has been a realtor and property manager with Keller Williams Flagship of Maryland.
He has also coached high school baseball and golf.
Schmidt was elected to the House of Delegates in November 2022.
He has been a Deputy Minority Whip since 2025 and sits on the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee; he served on the Judiciary Committee from 2023 to 2025.
He served on the board of the Anne Arundel County Association of Realtors from 2015 to 2022.
